title: `E0233`'s help for a nested `use` says it applies to the whole file, but a `use` covers only the code below it.
text: The help for a `use` written below file scope tells the reader the import applies to the whole file. The binary resolves a `use` only for the code after it, so a name used above the `use` is still unresolved. The help is product text, so its rewrite is held to AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*. It closes when the help says what the binary does, with a case that pins the new text.
